title: Critical exponents and hyperscaling relations at square-site p_c (D_f, gamma/nu, beta/nu, tau, 1/nu)
note: Successor of Q-P004 (thresholds; CLOSED H0_SUPPORTED). Measures the universality-class exponents at the exact site critical point p_c = 0.59274605079210(2) (Ziff PRL 117 125703 2016) via finite-size scaling of the open-cluster census, cluster-size distribution, and crossing width. Fresh streams; no EXP-0005/6/7 cells reused. HYP-005 was initially scaffolded as EXP-0008 but that ID was already claimed by prime-gaps Q-M002; re-issued as EXP-0009 on 2026-09-18 before any execution. TAU REFINEMENT (still pre-execution, 2026-09-18): the direct tau gate was re-scoped after architecture testing showed the finite-domain lattice-scale crossover gives an apparent exponent ~1.8-2.0 at s~10-10^3 that converges to the Fisher value 187/91 only asymptotically; the direct gate is now a wide apparent window + L-monotone trend, and the strict tau test is the hyperscaling relation R1 (tau = 1 + 2/D_f) broadened to 0.12. BUDGET REVISION (still pre-execution, same date): full-precision run measured 0.09 s/real at L=256 and 2.75 s/real at L=1024; statistics were trimmed (see parameters) so the whole experiment completes in ~25 min while keeping every bootstrap SE far below its gate tolerance; C6 mass/chi moved to L=256 (n=150/seed) and C7 subsample to L in {128,256,512}. Nothing else changed; all decided before any executed result. FROZEN before any execution.

tau.trend: tau_est rising toward 2.055 as L grows; gate: tau(L512) >= tau(L256) - se_tau(L512), tau(L1024) >= tau(L512) - se_tau(L1024), taus over the shared range [32, 2048]
tau.note: apparent finite-domain exponent ~1.8-2.0 due to lattice-scale crossover; STRICT tau test = hyperscaling relation R1

R3_Df_beta.use: algebraic comparison of measured D_f vs 2 - beta/nu_slope

gates.C1: full-cell rerun (L=256, p_c) cluster census bit-identical (sha256)
gates.C6: seed ladder on M_max, chi at L=256 (n=150/seed) and L=128 width W-curve (3 inner grid points, n=150/seed) within 3 joint-SE
gates.C7: pure-Python union-find independent implementation: L in {128,256,512}, subsample n=40, per-realization M_max and chi bit-identical, D_f subsample within 3 joint-SE
gates.FG: slope stability: refit D_f on inner sizes |d|<=0.02, gamma/nu |d|<=0.04
gates.PC1: bootstrap SE + chi2_red reported for every fit

decision_rule.H0_SUPPORTED: all gates PASS and P1-P5 in tolerance and R1-R3 in tolerance
decision_rule.ABNORMAL: gates PASS, some P/R out of tolerance
